items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: I had a cousin, Ray Fielder.

ctx.x: And we used to rehearse around there and we used to go to the trombone house and rehearse. I was on 8 and Liberty and I had a cousin, Ray Fielder. And he was playing drum, but every Sunday, remember, we used to rehearse on them. And some fella came in town by the name of Joe Wynn, looking for a band, and they got in the word of it. And so they made a deal with him. And the only thing about the deal was this fella, Joe Wynn, played drum.
